log.msg: JOB 1 — the `cut` hypothesis is ELIMINATED by measurement. 846 findings over 14 pages × 4 widths: 0 unresolvable paths, 0 findings whose node is a `cut` container, 12 nodes at the depth cap. Mechanically it cannot happen: probe.js:68-71 returns BEFORE pushing a culled child, so a culled node has no index and no rule can reference it. And a failed lookup rings NOTHING (highlight.js:49 `if (!el) return void $spot?.rc("on")`) — silent, never whole-page.

JOB 1 CAUSE A (the one Mike sees) — `dead-space` issues on `m.nodes[0]`, the analysis ROOT (rules.js:264,267). Root path is "" (probe.js:251-259 returns "" for root), and address.js:9 returns the root for an empty path, so the ring is `.app` = the entire window. It is gated at `m.viewport.w < 1500` (rules.js:255) — which is exactly why it is "sometimes": 0/42 top-3 findings at 390 and 1280, 1/42 at 1920, 5/42 at 3440 (36% of pages). 15 of the 16 root-ringing findings site-wide are this rule.

JOB 1 CAUSE B — the sibling roll-up (DesignTool.js:102-108) overwrites the finding's `path` with the PARENT's, and a page's direct children roll onto the page container. 47 findings ring a non-root box covering ≥60% of the viewport; 32 of 47 are rollups, 7 of 7 in the top-3. Targets measured: div.md.flow 390×25731, div.page.flow 334×4789, div.dt-audit.flow 348×25573. Correct attribution for the FIX, useless as a location.

JOB 1 CAUSE C — the ring is `position: fixed` (DesignTool.css:136) with a 12% wash and a 2px outline, so a target taller than the window shows 0 or 1 of its 4 edges: a translucent tint over everything, which IS the phrase "highlights the whole page". 14 findings at 390px ring a box with ≤1 visible edge AND 0% viewport cover — element below the fold, hover draws the ring off-screen and the reader sees nothing at all. 3 of 42 top-3 findings at 390.

JOB 1 headline: 13 of 167 top-3 findings (7.8%) offer a highlight that carries no information — 12% at 3440. Fix per cause: (A) no aim affordance when `path` is empty — the subject IS the page; (B) ring the exemplar child, name the container in the fix line; (C) clamp the ring to the viewport and mark the off-screen direction.

⚠ THE ACCURACY BUG, and it dwarfs the rest: OPENING THE DEVBAR MANUFACTURES ITS OWN TOP FINDING. `gutter` only considers scroll regions where `n.w < m.viewport.w - 2` (rules.js:123) — a geometric proxy for "this is not the shell". framework.css:170 pushes `.app` by 272px when the rail is open, so `.pages` becomes 1648 of 1920 and passes the test. Measured on 24 page×width pairs: rail closed → 0 `gutter` on `.pages`; rail open → `high · gutter · div.pages` on 18 of 24, and it is the TOP finding on 12 of those. Its ring is `div.pages` = 79% of the viewport. So the #1 whole-page ring is a finding that exists only because the tool is open.

FIX VERIFIED WITHOUT EDITING THE MODULE — compare against the ROOT'S CONTENT WIDTH (`nodes[0].cw - pad[1] - pad[3]`), the same number layout.js:183 already computes for the same reason. Recomputed over the live probe model: rail open @1280 10→0 gutter findings, @3440 13→1 (the survivor is a genuine inset `low·table`). And when the root has no inline padding the new expression is ARITHMETICALLY IDENTICAL to the old one — so the committed headless baseline (generated with no rail) cannot move. Zero regression risk.

JOB 3 measured — the layout screen carries 8 controls (block, ✕, 3 tabs, follow-the-resize, re-run, full report); the full report screen carries 20 (12 of them per-finding buttons at 272px). Of the 8, ZERO reflect the target, ZERO reflect selection, and exactly one reflects what-we're-looking-at (`full report`, unlabelled and one-way). The four width presets — the most important "what are we looking at" — live on a DIFFERENT tab from the readout that reports the width. Five states have no visible representation: which screen you are on, which finding is selected (dt-aimed is a 14%-alpha wash), the target marked on the page itself, page-width vs window-width (they differ by 272px and two tabs each show one), and staleness.

Annotated evidence in shots/: 20-annotated-clutter-1920.png (the readout's 4 identical rows + `grade undefined · undefined`), 21-annotated-wholepage-ring-3440.png (3440×1440 ring tagged div.app), 22-annotated-rail-causes-finding-1920.png (the gutter artifact), 23-annotated-390-covers-page.png (rail = 70% of a 390 window, page not pushed, ring lands under the rail). Raw: 01/02 the two screens at 1920, 04 at 390, 13/14 the page-tall rollup rings.
